'''Arnaud Chéritat''' (born June 7, 1975) is a French mathematician who works as a director of research at the [[Institut de Mathématiques de Toulouse]].<ref name="cv">[http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~cheritat/CV.pdf Curriculum vitae] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180713232514/http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~cheritat/CV.pdf |date=2018-07-13 }}, retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref> His research concerns [[complex dynamics]] and the shape of [[Julia set]]s.<ref>[http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~cheritat/rech.html Research statement], retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref>

Chéritat earned a [[licenciate]] in mathematics in 1995 from the [[École Normale Supérieure]], a [[Master of Advanced Studies|diplôme d'études approfondies]] in pure mathematics in 1996 from the [[University of Paris-Sud]], and a master's degree in pure and applied mathematics and informatics in 1998 from the École Normale Supérieure.<ref name="cv"/>
He defended his doctoral thesis in 2001 from the University of Paris-Sud, under the supervision of [[Adrien Douady]],<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=54271}}</ref> and completed his [[habilitation]] in 2008 from the [[University of Toulouse]].<ref name="cv"/> He worked as a [[Academic rank in France|maître de conférences]] at the University of Toulouse from 2002 until 2007, when he moved to the Institut de Mathématiques de Toulouse.<ref name="cv"/>

In 2006, Chéritat won the [[Leconte Prize]] of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref>[http://www.academie-sciences.fr/activite/prix/laureat_06.pdf Lauréats 2006 des Prix de l'Académie des sciences] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110808162943/http://www.academie-sciences.fr/activite/prix/laureat_06.pdf |date=August 8, 2011 }}, retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref> He was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2010.<ref>{{citation
 | last1 = Buff | first1 = Xavier
 | last2 = Chéritat | first2 = Arnaud
 | contribution = Quadratic Julia sets with positive area
 | mr = 2827861
 | pages = 1701–1713
 | publisher = Hindustan Book Agency | location = New Delhi
 | title = Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians. Volume III
 | year = 2010}}.</ref> In 2012, he became one of the inaugural [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref>

*with [[Artur Avila]] and [[Xavier Buff]]: {{cite journal|doi=10.1007/BF02392549|title=Siegel disks with smooth boundaries|journal=Acta Mathematica|volume=193|issue=1|year=2004|pages=1–30|last1=Avila|first1=Artur|last2=Buff|first2=Xavier|last3=Chéritat|first3=Arnaud|doi-access=free}}
*with Xavier Buff: {{cite journal|doi=10.1007/s00222-003-0331-6|title=Upper bound for the size of quadratic Siegel disks|journal=Inventiones Mathematicae|volume=156|issue=1|year=2004|pages=1–24|bibcode=2004InMat.156....1B|last1=Buff|first1=Xavier|last2=Chéritat|first2=Arnaud|s2cid=41612832}}
*with Xavier Buff: {{cite journal|title=The Brjuno function continuously estimates the size of quadratic Siegel disks|journal=Annals of Mathematics|year=2006|pages=265–312|jstor=20159990|volume=164|issue=1|doi=10.4007/annals.2006.164.265|arxiv=math/0401044|last1=Buff|first1=Xavier|last2=Chéritat|first2=Arnaud|s2cid=55781012}}
